placement.placementAuditNote: NIRF 2025 UG 4-year batch graduating 2023-24: 902 graduated, 76 to higher studies, 799 placed of 826 eligible. Median Rs 1,250,000. Headline CTC: Internal discrepancy in the same report, so the lowest institute-wide highest figure is used (D-23). Printed p.60: UG highest Rs 47 LPA, PG highest Rs 50 LPA, PhD 10.5 LPA, infographic 'Highest Package 51 Lakhs'. Printed p.38 table 'UG and PG Placements 2024 Graduating Batch': UG max 50.64 lakh, PG max 39.27 lakh; Director's message: UG 50.6, PG 39.3 lakh. Institute-wide max of the p.60 per-programme figures = 50 (PG). Figures are offers in lakh INR, domestic/international and CTC-vs-base not specified. Placement brochure 2024-25 (nitc-placement-brochure-2024-25.pdf, PDF p.21 'Last year's Placement Records') shows UG max 47, PG max 50 lakhs, matching p.60 but with no year stated. | CORRECTED after verification: UG B.Tech record uses the lowest UG institute-wide figure (47 LPA, Annual Report 2023-24 p.60); the 50 LPA figure is PG.
